adequacy_rule.rationale: 27/30 mirrors the v7 reference exposure (pilot 30/30, seed-variance 143/150 ~ 28.6/30); two consecutive checkpoints so a single lucky evaluation cannot set the budget.
adequacy_rule.selected_budget: cumulative timesteps at the LATER of the first two consecutive checkpoints whose FULL_EXPOSURE count is >= minimum_full_exposure_episodes

checkpoint_interval_note: 480 rollouts x 512 steps under the tuned recipe; every checkpoint boundary is a rollout boundary.
claim_boundary: Supports only the choice of a V2 training budget.
Does not support any statement about Walker2d locomotion quality, the artifact, or either arm's saturation.
disclosure: Pilot. Authored after probe V1's negative result was known. if_negative: V2 is not frozen on this recipe. Record PROBE_NEGATIVE_MAX_BUDGET_REACHED and propose a different recipe or plant as a new probe; never raise the maximum after seeing the curve.
purpose: Second budget probe after SECONDCASE-V2-BUDGET-PROBE-V1 returned PROBE_NEGATIVE_MAX_BUDGET_REACHED: with SB3 PPO defaults the reference arm never reached 27/30 full-horizon episodes within 2,949,120 steps (median realized steps stayed at ~270-560 of 1000 across all 12 checkpoints). This probe changes the RECIPE, not the plant, the arms, the rule or the adequacy threshold, to the published rl-baselines3-zoo tuned PPO configuration for Walker2d. The change is justified by an external source, not by our data; the maximum budget is 2x the zoo's own training budget and was fixed before any probe-V2 checkpoint was seen.
